title: LP1 embedded messages: remove the changing outer digit
question: Does a fixed one-character perimeter removal make the four LP1-10–13 signed-message diagrams identical inside, and does the same reading apply to the two visible LP1 five-by-five squares?
summary: The four extracted diagrams have border digits 3, 3, 0 and 1 but the same three-by-three interior after fixed perimeter removal. The two visible five-by-five squares have wholly different interiors; these are distinct source objects. No LP2 decryption follows.

family.title: LP1 signed-message diagram borders
family.question: Which exact repeated diagram changes at its perimeter while preserving its interior?

scope.representation: The exact ASCII bodies of four extracted PGP-verified OutGuess messages, with verification status read from page metadata; separately the printed LP1-05 mixed square converted by GP values and LP1-16 decimal square.
scope.procedure: Hash-check all inputs, locate each unique seven-line 16-column ASCII diagram, remove only its top/bottom rows and first/last character of other rows, and compare the resulting interior bytes and parsed decimal values in page order. Separately remove one-cell perimeters from both visible five-by-five squares to exclude that reading.
scope.parameters: Exactly LP1-10–13 in page order; one-character ASCII perimeter; no rotation, reflection, recoding or searched crop. The alternate LP1-05/16 check uses the canonical GP table from data/index.json.
scope.exclusions: No new GPG verification, no interpretation of the 3301 border sequence as a cipher, no LP2 text transformation, no claim that the common three-by-three is a magic square.

finding: All four signed-message bodies yield the same original-orientation interior [[10,12,10],[12,14,12],[10,12,10]] under the fixed crop. Their border digits read 3301 in page order. The inner row sums are 32, 38 and 32, so the interior is not magic. The visible LP1-05 and LP1-16 three-by-three cores are unequal and share no value.
limitations: The supplied discussion has image placeholders and does not name the four diagrams precisely; the identification here follows the thread's four repeated diagrams and the archived signed bodies. GPG validity is taken from preexisting page metadata, not newly reverified. This is an audit of a reported observation, not evidence of a decryption method or intended connection to the solved wording. Human review pending.
next_steps: If proposing perimeter removal for LP2, specify the exact page objects, border definition, selection rule and predicted output before testing. Keep the signed diagrams separate from the two visible five-by-five squares.

reproduction.environment: Python 3 standard library; no network or AI service. Run from the repository root or extracted bundle root.

review.reviewer: Codex; exact source-body parse, recorded signature-status check, independent regex oracle, alternate visible-square comparison; human review pending
